# MathDB agent Claim Reward body

Use with [mathdb](../award-process-mathdb.md) and the
[agent contract](../../agent-scope.md). Replace placeholders with reviewed public
facts. Repeat the category section for each category that independently passes
both technical and reward-condition checks. The submitting agent is not the
claimant. Keep personal replies and team decisions outside agent-owned updates.

Title: `[Claim Reward] JSP-XXXXXX — <qualifying categories>`

The [web form](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/claim-reward-mathdb.yml) collects
problem, contributor, category material and shared review-record links. This API
template also records the agent's handoff and review evidence. Link existing records instead of copying
their contents; a shared record may cover multiple items or categories if its
coverage is explicit.

## Handoff and actual claimant

This claim was handed off by the configured official MathDB agent.

- Authenticated agent account/App identity: <public identity>
- Opaque public handoff ID and review/event revision: <IDs>
- Rules version: mathdb
- Created/updated at (UTC): <timestamp>
- Actual claimant and stable MathDB user ID: <public attribution and ID>
- Public MathDB profile: <URL>
- GitHub account: <account or not available>
- Contribution and coauthors: <specific contributions and public evidence>
- Personal claim confirmation: **Pending claimant response**
- Identity verification: **Pending prize-team verification**

## Problem and cooperation scope

- JSP and catalog entry: <JSP and URL>
- MathDB problem ID and confirmed canonical URL: <ID and URL>
- Exact covered statement: <scope and correspondence evidence>
- Page-statement consistency: <confirmed formulation; conflicting statements resolved, not inferred from a tag>
- Approved pilot record and activation evidence: <links and rules version>

- Fixed material/publication version and stable link: <version and URL>

- Version and complete original-problem scope covered: <details>
- Current conclusion validity and trusted verification source: <record>
- Original public date and independently checkable history: <timestamp and evidence>
- Related results, prior claims, historical PRs and unresolved conflicts: <links or none>

For **Solution/Lean**:

- After-2026-01-01 check: <passed conclusion and original-date evidence>
- Earliest valid contribution check: <compared results, search scope, priority evidence>
- Agent's preliminary qualification conclusion: <passed and supporting record>

For **Lean**:

- Corresponding accepted mathematical solution: <fixed version and review>
- Original repository and branch: <URL and branch>
- Full 40-character commit SHA: <SHA>
- Proof files and fully qualified target theorems: <pinned locations>

For **Exposition**:

## Payment conditions and team review

- Applicable formally announced reward basis: <official reference or pending team determination>
- Claimed category shares: Solution 50%; Lean 30%; Exposition 20%, as applicable.
- Joint-author allocation: <pending team determination or applicable confirmed record>
- Solution complete-Lean payment condition: <MathDB verification / explicit external adoption / awaiting evidence / not applicable>
- External adoption, if used: <original repository, exact version, completeness/scope, external report, MathDB adoption conclusion>
- Team qualification/priority/attribution review: Pending
- Fourteen-day category public review and objections: Pending team publication
- Personal confirmation and identity: Pending

No estimated reward or problem level is supplied. Technical acceptance, this issue
and notification are not an award or a payment commitment.

## Notification status

- Claim issue link: <URL>
- Contributor notification: <pending / accepted by mail service at UTC time / failed>
- Prize-team Cc and Reply-To: thejustinsunprize@hejustinsun.com
- Required personal action: reply privately to the prize mailbox, link this issue,
  confirm own contribution and intent, and complete identity verification. Confirm
  the team's determined categories, reward and attribution in a later written reply.

No private email, identity documents or payment/delivery details belong here.

## Claimant response and prize-team record

Reserved for the actual claimant and team. The agent cannot sign a declaration
for the claimant or overwrite these records. The team records qualification,
identity/confirmation, category public-review dates, objections, applicable payment
conditions, announcement links and confirmed payment status here or by linked
public records; private correspondence remains private.
